text: Did you watch the news last night, Mai?
There was a terrible earthquake in Japan.
Oh no! Were there any casualties?
They haven't reported the exact number yet, but many buildings collapsed.
That's awful. Earthquakes are so unpredictable.
Yes. And there's also a warning for a tsunami. People in the coastal areas are being evacuated.
Have they sent rescue workers to the affected areas?
Yes, emergency teams are working hard to search for trapped people and provide medical supplies.
